chosen.premise: Jigglypuff freely changes its voice’s wavelength until the song matches a listener’s deep-sleep brain waves.
chosen.hook: Jigglypuff doesn’t just sing softly—it tunes its voice to your brain waves.
chosen.visualIdea: Display a voice wavelength adjusting against brain-wave lines until both patterns lock together and the target sleeps.
chosen.note: The wavelength-adjustment mechanic and deep-sleep brain-wave match are explicitly supported by multiple Pokédex entries. It is distinctive, easy to animate, and stronger than the generic idea that Jigglypuff simply sings people to sleep.

candidates.premise: Jigglypuff never pauses to breathe, so an opponent resisting sleep can endanger its life.
candidates.hook: Jigglypuff’s lullaby can literally become a life-threatening performance.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Jigglypuff singing as a sleep meter stays empty, then flash a warning as its breath runs out.
candidates.note: A highly specific and unusually dark mechanic unique to Jigglypuff. The danger is directly supported by Sapphire, while Sword reinforces that it keeps singing until foes sleep; support is slightly limited because the life-threatening consequence appears in only one entry.

candidates.premise: Jigglypuff sits between two evolution rules: friendship from Igglybuff, then a Moon Stone into Wigglytuff.
candidates.hook: Jigglypuff’s evolution chain switches from friendship to a Moon Stone.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Igglybuff’s friendship meter reaching 160, then replace it with a Moon Stone beside Jigglypuff.
candidates.note: A clear two-step evolution-rule switch with strong on-screen structure. It is well supported by the supplied evolution data, though the friendship threshold and methods come from trusted secondary data rather than the official Pokédex entries.

candidates.premise: Jigglypuff inflates its stomach to sing longer, turning its balloon-like body into extra performance time.
candidates.hook: Jigglypuff’s stomach is a built-in upgrade for longer lullabies.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Jigglypuff swelling up beside a countdown that extends as its lullaby continues.
candidates.note: The inflation-to-sing-longer connection is concrete and visually clear, but it is less surprising and less mechanically detailed than the wavelength or breath-danger angles.

candidates.premise: Jigglypuff’s lullabies change by region, with some regional versions sounding like outright shouting.
candidates.hook: Not every Jigglypuff sings a lullaby the same way.
candidates.visualIdea: Cut between region labels with contrasting song waveforms, ending on one waveform styled like a shout.
candidates.note: The regional variation, including shouting-like songs, is a good contradiction to Jigglypuff’s familiar lullaby image. However, it rests on one entry and lacks named regions or a more measurable comparison.

rounds.request: None; brainwave-tuning is strong enough. A stronger alternative would need an equally explicit, Jigglypuff-specific mechanic with a sharper contradiction or consequence and direct support from multiple entries.
